name: Hero's Journey
description: Twelve stages of departure, initiation and return, after Campbell and Vogler.

beats.name: Ordinary World
beats.hint: The hero at home, before the adventure, with what they lack.

beats.name: Call to Adventure
beats.hint: A problem or challenge appears that cannot be ignored for long.

beats.name: Refusal of the Call
beats.hint: Fear or duty holds the hero back, at least for a moment.

beats.name: Meeting the Mentor
beats.hint: Someone offers advice, training or a gift for the road.

beats.name: Crossing the Threshold
beats.hint: The hero commits and enters the unfamiliar world.

beats.name: Tests, Allies, Enemies
beats.hint: The hero learns the rules of the new world and who stands where.

beats.name: Approach to the Inmost Cave
beats.hint: Preparation for the central ordeal; tension gathers.

beats.name: The Ordeal
beats.hint: The hero faces their greatest challenge so far and must survive it.

beats.name: Reward
beats.hint: Having survived, the hero takes what they came for, and maybe more.

beats.name: The Road Back
beats.hint: The hero sets out for home, often pursued.

beats.name: Resurrection
beats.hint: A final, purifying test where everything learned is put to use.

beats.name: Return with the Elixir
beats.hint: The hero comes home changed, with something that changes their world too.
